summary: Reels lose 61% viewers in first 3 seconds – hook fails. Bio targets niches/region, promises 24hr delivery and free audit, violating rules.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: rotate to **question** or **top3** (highest relative scores) but keep it one clear pain point.
- Avoid repeating "DIY vs professional" or "cost comparison" phrasing – used in last 3 animated_ads posts.
- Posts must read like a developer sharing real work: show a frame or code snippet, not a sales pitch.
- Use silhouette or desk-glow image style; they outperformed others.
- No demos, free audits, or niche examples – only general explanation + pay-after-approval offer.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 common objections small Indian businesses have about video ads (budget, time, technical skill) from Reddit/Quora threads, not from competitors.
instructions.analysis: Compare the last 3 animated_ads posts: all used comparison hooks. Note which angle (mistake, myth_bust) got any saves/shares – use that angle today.
instructions.writer: Write a single carousel: slide 1 = question hook (e.g., "What stops you from running video ads?"), slides 2-3 = general how AI animation works (no demo), slide 4 = pay-after-approval + DM for advice. No niche mentions.
instructions.image: Create a silhouette-style carousel cover: dark background, glowing outline of a phone playing a video, text "AI animated ads" – no logos, no client names.
instructions.video: Skip video today; static carousel performs 3.7x better per reach. If you must, film a 5-second screen-record of the animation timeline (no client branding) with a caption overlay.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio: remove niches, region, "24 hrs", and free audit. Keep only: "AI chatbots, animated ads, lead gen, websites for Indian small businesses. Pay after approval. DM for advice."
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small business owners (cafes, gyms, clinics) about their marketing struggles – no self-promo.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from followers with a genuine question about their ad challenges.
